ChatGPT users can now reserve restaurants and join waitlists through Yelp directly within their conversations. Details below.

Yelp expands ChatGPT integration

A few weeks ago, Yelp and ChatGPT established a content integration partnership, bringing Yelp's reviews, ratings, photos, and other business information directly into ChatGPT's responses.

Yelp announced today that it is expanding this integration, allowing users in the United States and Canada to book tables and join waitlists through Yelp without leaving the chat interface.

Yelp stated:

With both features combined, users can obtain recommendations and instantly book a table or join a waitlist when seats are available — all within a single conversation. The entire reservation process, including party size, date and time, contact details, special requests, and confirmation, is fully covered.

Yelp noted that this integration further expands the platform's presence in AI search, including through natural citations. Yelp mentioned in the press release: "Yelp is the most cited home services discovery platform, with citations on major AI platforms 3.4 times higher than its closest competitor."

For more information about the new Yelp and ChatGPT integration, please visit the link below.
